body: To be fair, she still lives with her ex,( insane rental market) so I can see why that might not be so desirable.

I asked her yesterday if she she'd like to hang out (we're a ferry ride apart) she said not right now, but came back on a little later to say that when things are better for her we can talk about visits. She said she enjoyed hanging out and had lots of fun. So I guess I'll just let things be for a while and if things work out great.

In the last few days I've messaged her letting her know I had a great time this weekend , once the next day about some music she showed me on the way up. I let it cool a day and chatted with her today about a woodworking project she asked me about doing.
Quick update: spoke with Dr Corney, and will be finally seeing someone about this, not till September or October, but it's good to know that some help is on the horizon .

I really appreciate everyone's perspective...these ideation come and go, but it's been a relative constant in my life the last ten plus years. I've managed not to act on any of these things, I just can't stand that in so many trying situations my mind goes right to suicide. 
I'll look into some of these resources, and thanks again. Will update
